note: operation_score is the mean over the hidden episodes of the shift's score (skidcell.episode: start-up 0.20, operation in band 0.25, the window's events 0.25, shutdown 0.15, the log sheet 0.15; a void scores the episode 0), already on [0, 1]; ratio = score / value, reward = clamp(ratio / full_at, 0, 1).
source: reference program (tests/reference: privileged eyes for the robot's motions only; its decisions use what an operator can see, the instruments' readings, lamps, sight glasses and drums, never the process's hidden state) on seeds 1-64 of cell version 0.3.0 (2026-11-06): episode score mean 0.9646, sd 0.038, min 0.813, median 0.974; no voids or safety violations; the strainer slug, supply loss, drum change and pump trip procedures credited on every seed, the dosing air lock on 84 %, the demand step on 94 %. Bootstrap of 4-episode means (the grader's episodes): 0.1 % quantile 0.8878, 0.5 % 0.9033, 5 % 0.9293; full_at 0.92 keeps the oracle's reward at 1.0 down to the 0.1 % quantile (0.8878 / 0.965 / 0.92 = 1.000). Until this revision the reference also read the process's hidden state (anchor 0.968 / 0.94 on cell versions 0.2-0.3); v0.1's anchor was 0.988 / 0.95.
